description: NVDB på karta is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by nvdbpakarta.trafikverket.se. Web application that makes it possible to see all of Sweden's roads and cycle paths stored in the National Road Database (NVDB). You can choose to look at several different properties (data types) that apply to a certain route. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "NVDB on map" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include map service, karttjänst, NVDB. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2024-10-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
